{{Dablink|This article is about '''Permacrete'''. Not to be confused with '''[[Ferrocrete/Legends|Ferrocrete]]'''.}}
[[File:Permacrete.png|thumb|right|Permacrete]]
'''Permacrete''' was a very strong and heat resistant material. It was used mostly in the construction of landing pads and pits for [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and as paving for roads.
